name: hud_ui_panel_set_text_colors_and_mark_dirty
description: HudUiPanel::SetTextColorsAndMarkDirty stores the primary and alternate text colors and marks the panel text as dirty.
known_limits: tier S verification uses the existing local VC target hud_ui_panel_set_text_colors_and_mark_dirty.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x40e010 stores color0 at HudUiPanel offset 0x14c, stores color1 at offset 0x150, sets textDirty at offset 0x270 to one, and returns void.
Native smoke zhud_panel_text_color_shadow_smoke calls SetTextColorsAndMarkDirty and verifies offsets 0x14c and 0x150 receive the two color arguments and offset 0x270 is set to one.
